statement: You are given an array prices, where prices[i] is the price of a stock on day i.
You may buy one share on one day and sell it on a later day. Return the largest profit (selling price minus buying price) you can make.
If no later price is higher than an earlier one, make no trade and return 0.

examples.explanation: Buy on day 1 at price 1 and sell on day 4 at price 6, for a profit of 5.
The price falls every day, so any trade would lose money and the answer is 0.
